On the wet sand lay her father's compass, still warm, its needle pointing toward the lighthouse instead of north.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂时停泊的船。路灯把空荡的街道染成淡金色，清洁工推着小车，扫起昨夜留下的纸屑。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃缓缓上升。远处，一辆末班货车驶过桥面，声音很快沉入寂静。有人刚刚入睡，有人已经出门，天边还没有亮，生活却悄悄翻开了新的一页。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one too.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
